ES-MAD-BERRUGUETE.wfs_outcome: HTTP 400 'No se puede procesar su peticion' is returned to the LITERAL curl/* User-Agent and to nothing else. Measured 2026-08-27 on one URL across four clients: curl/8.5.0 -> 400; python-requests/2.32.3 -> 200; a custom OpenUBEM/1.0 -> 200; an EMPTY User-Agent -> 200. It is a curl blocklist, not a browser check - which is why the parallel requests-based probe of the same endpoint never saw the gate and this shell-based probe always did. ListStoredQueries returns GetBuildingByParcel, GetFeatureById, GetBuildingPartByParcel, GetOtherBuildingByParcel, GetAllConstructionByParcel - every STORED query is keyed on a cadastral reference - but an AD HOC TYPENAMES=bu:Building + BBOX GetFeature DOES work, requiring the ',urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326' suffix and lat,lon axis order (TYPENAME singular is rejected). This probe used the ATOM bulk route instead, which is equally valid.

IT-BOL-GALVANI2.istat_note: the census layers the portal does publish (sezioni-di-censimento 2001/2011/2021) are TRACT-level statistics. An ISTAT epoch distribution per tract is a statistical prior, not an observed per-building year, and cannot satisfy MISSING_OBSERVED_YEAR_BUILT.

independent_corroboration.note: a PARALLEL session measured the same ruling over the same bboxes by a different route (tiled ad hoc WFS bbox instead of the ATOM bulk download). Both artefacts are kept; neither supersedes the other.

es_features_in_bbox.explanation: both are envelope tests; this one filters on the feature's own gml:Envelope and slightly over-includes

agreement.verdict: the two measurements corroborate: ES coverage ~99 percent and the join ~98-99 percent by every predicate tried

independent_corroboration.gate_reconciled: the two sessions recorded contradictory things about this endpoint because they used different HTTP clients. Re-measured across four User-Agents, both records are explained by a curl blocklist. The disagreement between two parallel probes is what produced the sharper fact.

superseded_conclusion: a THIRD ceiling was measured by that parallel session AFTER this probe closed and is NOT reflected in the numbers above: the ruled layout contract accepts only 63 of Madrid's 1,194 footprints and 204 of the 4,186 across all four sites, which is roughly four times tighter than the attribute ceiling this probe measured. That was raised as decision request D-EU-23 and RULED the same day, Option G1: S3 = 96 in MIXED MODE - dwelling-partitioned wherever the EU-04 contract emits, the ruled one_zone_per_floor fallback everywhere else, with the layout axis and the simulation axis in separate columns and printed in every S3 acceptance panel - and the FR + ES ingestion this probe routed to is AUTHORISED on that basis (Lyon + Madrid). The geometry contract was NOT reopened; G2 and G3 were refused. Standing caveat: S3's headline 96 does not imply dwelling-level geometry and no S3 result may be quoted without its partitioned / massing split. Nothing measured here is withdrawn - attribute coverage is still confirmed for Spain - but 'S3 is FR + ES' is not yet 'S3 is formable'.
